name: The Western Front
summary: Farholde's patrol has gone missing along the western borders. With Miss Amberhall's findings pointing toward a Twilight Hammer encampment, you are asked to find Sergeant Riftan near the Twilight's Shroud.

sections.title: A Missing Patrol
sections.body: A Farholde patrol vanished from the western borders, and Sergeant Riftan is among those unaccounted for. Miss Amberhall's findings raise concern that the patrol reached the Twilight Hammer's central encampment. You are asked to look for Riftan near the Twilight's Shroud to the west.

faq.answer: A Farholde patrol disappeared from the western borders. Sergeant Riftan is the one you are asked to find.

faq.q: Where should I look for Sergeant Riftan?
faq.answer: Sergeant Riftan is near the Twilight's Shroud to the west.
Miss Amberhall's findings lead Farholde to fear the patrol walked into the Twilight Hammer's central encampment.
Miss Amberhall is the lady whose findings raise concern that the patrol reached the Twilight Hammer's central encampment.
Farholde says it can handle the cleanup in Sunnyglade itself, while you are asked to check on Sergeant Riftan.
